_comment: Mutation testing (testing.md §6): high coverage with weak assertions still
ships bugs. Stryker makes small breaking edits to the source and asserts the
suite goes red; a SURVIVING mutant is a line the tests execute but do not
This repo needed it. On 2026-07-31 storage.js had passing tests and no real
assertions behind them -- the mock never executed SQL -- and a syntax error
shipped to production. Mutation testing is the mechanical form of that
question: 'if I broke this line, would anything notice?'
NOT a per-PR gate: it is slow (it reruns the suite once per mutant). Run it
nightly or before a release, on the CORE decision code only -- the modules
where a survivor means a vendor can read green when it is not.
Adapters are deliberately excluded: they are already pinned against recorded
vendor payloads, which is a stronger guarantee than mutation score, and
including them makes a run take long enough that nobody runs it.
